newsitem.title: USA: K-III will not proceed with share offering.
newsitem.headline: K-III will not proceed with share offering.

text.p: K-III Communications Corp said Tuesday it will not proceed with its previously announced offering of 12.5 million shares.
"When we announced our intention to make the offering, our stock was trading at 12-5/8," said William Reilly, chairman and chief executive. "At current levels we are not sellers of stock."
K-III closed at 10-1/2 Monday and was up 7/8 at 11-3/8 in early afternoon trading today.
The company said it continues to believe there is merit to increasing the float of its stock over time, but it does not need the cash from such an offering to pursue its growth strategy.
Separately, K-III said its Business Directory Division had acquired IntelliChoice Inc, a source of information on automobile ownership costs for businesses and consumers.
